description: Cancels a booking by booking_id (as returned by list_current_bookings) and reports the updated status together with the refunded amount; on failure it returns an error naming the reason, e.g. booking not found. Client-initiated cancellation is accepted up to 48 hours before check-in, which refunds in full; later than that the API refuses and the guest settles it with the hostel directly. The agent needs no per-action approval — the one-time Telegram consent already covers cancellations.

booking_id.description: The booking to cancel, as returned in booking_id by list_current_bookings. An integer, not a UUID.

name: cancel
